title: Community Engagement Manager, Data Centers (Indiana & Kentucky)
description:
Headquarters: Remote-Friendly, United States

 About Anthropic

 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

 About the role

 Anthropic is building AI systems that will shape the trajectory of one of the most consequential technologies in human history. That work requires physical infrastructure at significant scale, and building that infrastructure the right way means being a real, long-term partner to the communities where we operate.

 We are looking for a Community Engagement Manager in Indiana and Kentucky to join our Public Policy team and serve as Anthropic's on-the-ground presence in the communities where our data centers are sited, built, and operated. This is not a communications role or a government affairs role, though you will do elements of both. It is a relationship role: your job is to make Anthropic a trusted, visible, and valued neighbor, from the earliest stages of site selection through construction and long-term operations.

 You will be the connective tissue between Anthropic's Policy and Infrastructure teams and the local officials, community organizations, economic development partners, and residents who have a stake in what we build. You will surface concerns before they escalate, translate our technical and operational plans into clear local benefits, and build the coalitions that allow us to move quickly and responsibly. Because Anthropic's infrastructure footprint is still early in its growth, you will also help write the playbook: the processes you build in your first markets are the ones we will use as we expand.

 You will travel regularly within Indiana and Kentucky, up to 50% of the time, and occasionally to other Anthropic data center markets.

 Key responsibilities

•
 Build and maintain trusted, sustained relationships with county commissioners and councils, Kentucky fiscal courts and judge-executives, mayors and city councils, plan commissions and zoning boards, state and regional economic development organizations, community groups, civic leaders, educational institutions, and workforce partners in the Indiana and Kentucky data center markets you cover

•
 Develop and execute a community engagement strategy for each of your markets, spanning site selection, pre-development, construction, and ongoing operations

•
 Build external coalitions, host education and listening sessions, and design local solutions that deliver real benefits to the communities where we operate

•
 Represent Anthropic in public forums, town halls, planning hearings, community events, and local media

•
 Monitor community sentiment and local political dynamics, and advise internal teams on risks, opportunities, and the right pace and posture for engagement

•
 Partner with the Real Estate and Infrastructure team to bring community input into how projects are planned, communicated, and delivered, not just how they are announced

•
 Work with the Communications team to develop proactive, locally relevant messaging

•
 Coordinate charitable giving, community investment, and economic development commitments in your markets, including managing nonprofit partner relationships

•
 Partner with the Energy and Sustainability team to explain our approach to environmental stewardship and respond to questions about power, water, and land use, including how large electricity needs are served by local utilities and rural electric cooperatives

•
 Build a community engagement playbook and repeatable processes that scale as Anthropic's infrastructure footprint grows

 Minimum qualifications

•
 Experience in community affairs, public affairs, economic development, government relations, local or state government, or a closely related field

•
 Direct experience working for or engaging with county and municipal governments and a broad set of community stakeholders on behalf of large infrastructure, construction, energy, or technology projects, with a working understanding of how local politics and community dynamics actually play out

•
 A skilled relationship and coalition builder who earns trust with a diverse group of stakeholders, and who maintains relationships through difficult conversations

•
 The ability to represent a company credibly in public settings, including town halls, hearings, and press interviews

•
 Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to turn a complex operational plan into plain language that a local official or reporter can understand and respond to

•
 The ability to work independently, get up to speed quickly on complex policy issues, and manage multiple concurrent engagements across different markets without losing track of any of them

•
 Based in Indiana or Kentucky or willing to relocate to one of them, and prepared to travel regularly across both states

 Preferred qualifications

•
 7+ years of experience in community engagement specifically on data center, utility, energy, or large-scale industrial infrastructure projects, or in local government

•
 Familiarity with land use, zoning, and permitting processes at the county and municipal level in Indiana and/or Kentucky, including local tax abatement and incentive approvals

•
 Experience managing corporate social responsibility programs

•
 Established relationships with economic development, workforce, or civic organizations in the markets this role covers

•
 Experience working with real estate, legal, communications, and policy teams at the same time

•
 A genuine interest in the communities where you work, not just the projects you are managing

 The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

 For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

 Annual Salary:
 $265,000 — $295,000 USD

 Logistics

 Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

 Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

 Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

 Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

 Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

 We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

 Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

 How we're different

 We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

 The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

 Come work with us!

 Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

 To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/anthropic-community-engagement-manager-data-centers-indiana-kentucky

title: Anthropic STEM Fellow
description:
Headquarters: Remote-Friendly, United States; San Francisco, CA

 About Anthropic

 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

 Program Overview

 Some of our world's grand challenges, from resolving long-open problems in mathematics to designing medicines for neglected diseases, require deep expert judgment that today's AI still lacks. We're working toward an AI scientist, a system capable of the long-horizon reasoning and experimental judgment needed to push the frontier on problems like these. We believe frontier AI, developed safely, can meaningfully accelerate progress across science and engineering. Getting there requires close collaboration with people who have spent years at the frontier of their fields.

 The Anthropic STEM Fellows Program brings researchers and experts from across science and engineering into Anthropic for four months to take on the grand challenges of their fields with Claude. Working in small pods of Fellows from related fields, you will pair deep domain expertise with our frontier models and internal tooling to define the hardest open problems in your discipline, build the datasets and simulations that let us test and train Claude on them, and find exactly where it falls short.

 We're looking for Fellows across science and engineering. Prior machine learning experience is helpful but not required. Scientific judgment and a willingness to learn quickly matter more.

 Our first cohort of more than 20 STEM Fellows across mathematics, physics, the life sciences, and engineering, ran from June to September 2026. The problems they built now feed Claude's training and one of our internal science evaluations.

 What to Expect:

• A place in a small pod of Fellows working on related problems in your domain. Your pod meets weekly with Anthropic researchers to share methods, pressure-test ideas, and build on each other's work.

• A grand challenge at the frontier of your field: an ambitious, open-ended problem scoped with our research team so you can make real progress in four months.

• Access to frontier Claude models and internal evaluation tooling.

 Compensation:

 $100,000–$167,000 USD for the four-month fellowship (equivalent to $300,000–$500,000 USD annualized), and other benefits.

 Key responsibilities

• Setting grand challenges for your field: identifying long-horizon open problems where Claude falls short of expert judgment, and defining what real progress on them looks like.

• Building comprehensive datasets, simulations and rigorous, hard-to-game evaluations that test whether models can plan experiments, interpret data and reason about mechanisms, and systematically finding where they're confidently wrong.

• Applying Claude to open problems in your domain, using test-time compute strategies and integrating the scientific tools and software your field relies on.

 Minimum qualifications

• Are excited about the potential for AI to reason well about hard questions in their field where expert judgment matters.

• Hands-on experience using Claude and Claude Code in your day-to-day workflow.

• Hold a PhD in a STEM field and have several years of experience (eg post-doc or faculty).

• Are comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-agency atmosphere for a few months and delivering concrete results.

• Existing authorization to work in the United States for the duration of the program.

 Logistics - Fellows

• The program runs from January 12th to May 8th 2027 , and is full-time for the duration; some fellowships may be considered for an extension.

• Applications are open until October 28, 2026 , and we plan to make offers by November 20th. Later stages will typically include a take-home exercise and conversations with our research team about your research interests and possible project directions.

• We ask that all Fellows attend a one-week in-person orientation in San Francisco.

• The default location is in San Francisco. We will consider remote engagements within the United States in certain circumstances.

• We are not currently able to sponsor visas for fellows. To participate in the Fellows program, you need to have or independently obtain full-time work authorization in the United States.

• This is a fixed-term contract position. Fellows are engaged through an employer of record, rather than employed directly by Anthropic.

title: Project Manager
description:
Location of this role

UK only - no sponsorship is offered.

What we are looking for?

We are looking for an experienced Project Manager to execute the global delivery strategy.

Your mission will be ensuring the successful and high-quality delivery of technology solutions to our clients exceeding their expectations, by being the glue between our clients and our teams, fostering collaboration, building strong relationships, and nurturing a culture of excellence.

What your main functions will look like

Your projects could be commercially structured as fixed price, T&M, support, or augmented and you will be in charge of planning, scheduling, budget tracking, budget forecasting, execution and delivery of software and web projects. You will ensure the successful completion as well as overseeing the team working on the projects.

In this position, you will play a critical role in the following areas:

  • Collaborate to successfully meet the strategic KPIs and goals set for the Delivery department (e.g. CSAT score, etc.).
  • Manage client needs and expectations, fostering positive relationships, and delivering exceptional client satisfaction.
  • Own the delivery of several engagements, managing scope, schedule, risks, and issues to ensure delivery is aligned with our contractual commitments.
  • Ensure roadmaps are prioritized to guarantee that delivery teams deliver continuous releases and meet established deadlines.
  • Monitor client engagements with appropriate delivery reporting metrics (e.g. health checks, risks log, etc.), taking actions proactively based on this information.
  • Review new contracts or scope of work extensions.
  • Have a constant overview of the budget of the engagements you manage, creating and monitoring billing plans to understand the actual VS planned revenue and take actions proactively as needed. This will also include budget forecasting in relation to the completion of the project, where appropriate.
  • Review and approve the timesheets, to ensure your clients are invoiced accurately by Finance.
  • Manage staffing needs, ensuring early visibility and effective planning for changes on capacity, budget, and opportunities related to the engagements you are managing.
  • Collaborate with presales activities when required (e.g. providing advice, presenting our ways of working and previous experience to a client, etc.)
  • Support the onboarding process of new employees who join the company and the engagement you are managing.
  • Foster the team's motivation and engagement, promoting a culture of empowerment, feedback, and collaboration.
  • Support the mentors, line managers and mentees that are part of the delivery teams you manage, providing guidance and fostering key performance management activities (e.g. 1on1, goals management, etc.).

Minimum qualifications

  • At least 5 years of experience in a Project Management role.
  • Strong communication & active listening skills in English.
  • Ability to successfully take both agile and waterfall approaches as needed, depending on the nature of the project and contract.
  • Effective budget, risks, and issues management skills, with a high level of proactivity and adaptability to solve problems and make sound decisions.
  • Orientation to results & client satisfaction, with solid planning & time management abilities that enable proper expectations management and delivering on our word.
  • Ability to foster collaborative environments that empower employees, build strong relationships, encourage candid feedback, and recognize achievements.

What One Beyond is committed to providing to you!

  • Attractive benefits package applies.

Please keep in mind this job post defines our ideal candidate. Although you don’t match all the requirements, don’t be afraid to apply!

title: Teaching Assistant (Supported Learning Group)
description:
Clyst Vale is a thriving and vibrant 11- 16 Community College situated five miles from Exeter. Visitors to Clyst Vale usually comment on the friendly, orderly atmosphere, the courtesy of our students, and the purposefulness in lessons. We have clear expectations and systems, but far more important are the excellent working relationships we establish between staff and students, as well as staff and parents. We remain the only Secondary school in Devon to be accredited Gold Rights Respecting School status.

The role

We are seeking a committed and enthusiastic Grade D Teaching Assistant to join our supportive and friendly team. The successful candidate will work closely with teachers to support high‑quality learning, provide targeted interventions, and help create a positive, inclusive environment for pupils who are starting at a new provision within the College.

The Supported Learning Group (SLG) comprises of 15 Year 7 students who joined us in September. These students follow a highly differentiated, primary style curriculum, covering a broad range of subjects in Key Stage 3 and then working towards functional skills and life skills qualifications in Key Stage 4. This is a unique opportunity to work with students who have EHCPs with needs in communication and interaction and cognition and learning who are extremely vulnerable but keen to attend school and access learning.

The role will involve supporting students in their specialised and mainstream lessons; developing strong working relationships with their teachers, running 1:1 and small group interventions and becoming one of the trusted key adults in their team. The role will involve working exclusively with this class and following them from Year 7-11 as they move up through the College.

Please see the job description and person specification for full details of the role.

Salary

Actual salary £17,968-£19,156

We are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and expect all staff and volunteers to share this commitment. An enhanced DBS check is required for all successful candidates.

CVs are not accepted, please complete the application form in full. If you can meet the requirements of this role, we would love to hear from you. All applications should be made by completing the online application form via E-teach available at http://www.bep.ac/vacancies and include evidence of how you meet the person specification for the role. For full details of the role, please see the job description and person specification. 

Please note we do not offer Skilled Worker visa sponsorship to non-UK citizens for this role.

As part of our due diligence process when shortlisting, we may carry out an online search of publicly available material to identify any incidents or issues which we might want to explore with the applicant at interview. We also reserve the right to interview prospective candidates at any point and to close the advert early.

We will be reviewing applications as they come in and may invite strong candidates for an interview before the closing date. To ensure your application is considered, please apply promptly. See the Job Description for a full breakdown of the role and responsibilities.

title: Senior Operations Manager
description:
Job Title:  Senior Operations Manager  

Actual Annual Salary: £44,818 - £48,280 (CLF Grade G) based on full time hours, all year round 

Contract Type:  Permanent 

Hours:  Full-Time, 37 hours per week, All Year Round 

Provisional Start Date: 01 February 2027 

Are you an experienced operational leader looking to make a real difference in education? Broadoak Academy is seeking a highly organised, proactive and strategic Senior Operations Manager to play a pivotal role in the effective leadership and day-to-day running of the Academy. This role will work closely with the Principal, leading on the non-educational functions that enable staff and students to thrive. 

As a key member of the Academy's leadership team, you will lead the Professional Services function, providing strategic oversight of administration, compliance, health and safety, HR support and recruitment activities. You will be responsible for ensuring robust systems, processes and procedures are in place, supporting the smooth operation of the Academy and maintaining the highest standards of compliance and safeguarding.  

About you:  

You will: 

  • Lead and manage the Professional Services team, including administrative staff, ensuring high-quality service delivery across the Academy. 
  • Act as the operational lead for Health & Safety, compliance, policy implementation, GDPR and risk management. 
  • Support the Principal and Senior Leadership Team on all non-education aspects of Academy operations, providing advice, oversight and practical solutions. 
  • Oversee HR administration and recruitment processes, supporting the delivery of safer recruitment practices and staff compliance requirements. 
  • Ensure statutory responsibilities, including safeguarding compliance and maintenance of the Single Central Record, are effectively managed. 
  • Drive continuous improvement, developing systems and procedures that enhance efficiency and support the Academy's strategic priorities. 

Applicants are advised to refer to the full requirements of the role in the attached job description and person specification, prior to submitting an application.  

About Broadoak Academy:  

Broadoak Academy is an ever-growing secondary school located in Weston-super-Mare and is quickly becoming the school of choice for parents in the town. We are very proud to be an Ofsted-rated ‘Good’ school. We have a strong sense of belonging and community, and as such, we work together to offer students a well-balanced, happy and successful education. Our community is assured of Broadoak’s pivotal role in their children’s education, wellbeing and futures. 

Why work at CLF? 

We are a diverse and inclusive community of 37 academies across five cluster regions in the South West that is committed to excellence and making a positive impact. Our people bring unique perspectives, but we’re all driven by a shared moral purpose and a passion for making a positive impact, whether in a teaching, leadership or support role. We’re proud to foster a culture where everyone can thrive, feel valued, and make a meaningful difference to the lives of others. 

We are an equal opportunity employer and proud to serve a diverse student population and our communities. We strongly believe that representation matters and so encourage applications from underrepresented and global majority groups including ethnicity, gender, transgender, age, disability, sexual orientation or religion. 

We aim to remove any barriers to employment, ensuring everyone can compete on equal terms. 

What we can offer you:  

  • Access to a generous pension through the Local Government Pension Scheme (LGPS).  
  • Generous annual leave.  
  • A comprehensive induction and ongoing commitment to wellbeing and career progression, through a range of training, apprenticeships and in-role/wider-trust development opportunities.  
  • Well-being support through an Employee Assistance Programme.  
  • Health benefits, including wellness sessions, gym discounts, and flu jabs.  
  • A range of generous family leave options, including above industry average occupational maternity pay.  
  • Additional benefits like cycle to work scheme, on-site parking plus many more!  

Recruitment timeline:  

  • Closing Date: 06 December 2026 @11.59pm  
  • Shortlisting: 07 December 2026 
  • Interviews: 15 December 2026 

If you would like to discuss this opportunity prior to the closing date, please contact our recruitment team who will arrange a suitable time.  

As part of our commitment to Keeping Children Safe in Education (KCSIE), we do not accept CVs – a full education and employment history must be provided through our application form.  

Skilled Worker sponsorship: This role may be eligible for Skilled Worker visa sponsorship, subject to the candidate meeting the applicable Home Office eligibility and salary requirements. Full-time and 0.8 FTE positions will generally meet the required salary threshold; for other part-time working arrangements, eligibility will depend on the salary applicable to the role and the candidate's working pattern. To help us assess whether sponsorship may be available, we encourage candidates who require sponsorship to provide their current salary information when completing the application form.   

We reserve the right to close this vacancy early, should we receive a high level of interest in the role. Therefore, candidates are advised to apply at their earliest convenience to avoid missing out. 

As a Disability Confident Committed Employer, we are dedicated to equity and inclusion and commit to interviewing applicants with a disability who meet the essential criteria. We aim to provide an inclusive and accessible recruitment process, and support employees throughout their employment. If you have a disability, are neurodivergent, or require any adjustments to support you through the application or interview process please let us know how we can assist.

title: Assistant Principal
description:
Job Title: Assistant Principal   

Contract: Fixed Term Contract until 31 August 2027 (maternity contract) 

Actual Salary: L3 - L8 (£56,298 - £63,688) 

Start Date: January 2027 

Bring your vision, resilience and passion for learning to a school where excellence, equity and continuous improvement are at the heart of everything we do. 

Summerhill Academy is seeking an enthusiastic, dynamic and committed Assistant Principal with teaching responsibilities to join our Senior Leadership Team. Working closely with the Principal and wider leadership team, you will play a key role in both the strategic direction and day-to-day operation of the academy, helping to drive whole-school improvement and ensure the best possible outcomes for every child. 

Located in St George, Bristol, Summerhill Academy is a junior school at the heart of a diverse and vibrant community. We are proud to offer a broad, inspiring and ambitious curriculum that reflects the needs of our pupils and provides opportunities for every child to flourish. 

Our commitment to high standards of teaching and learning is underpinned by a kind, caring and inclusive environment where every child is valued, supported and encouraged to succeed. We want our pupils to leave Summerhill Academy with a strong sense of community and purpose, equipped with the knowledge, skills and confidence they need to achieve their full potential and thrive in the future. 

As Assistant Principal, you will work collaboratively with the leadership team to build on the academy’s existing strengths, maintain its high standards and lead further improvement. This is an exciting opportunity to make a meaningful contribution to the continued success of the school, providing additional leadership capacity and supporting the effective delivery of our shared vision. A key priority of the role will be the induction, mentoring and professional development of colleagues who are new to the academy, including Early Career Teachers (ECTs). You will take on the role of dedicated Induction Tutor and mentor, providing high-quality guidance, support and challenge to help colleagues develop their practice and confidence. You will also work closely with teachers across their respective year groups to strengthen the quality of teaching and learning and ensure consistently positive experiences and outcomes for our pupils. 

We are looking for a leader who combines ambition with compassion, brings energy and fresh thinking to their work, and is committed to developing both people and practice. If you are passionate about educational excellence, inclusive leadership and making a lasting difference to the lives of children and colleagues, we would love to hear from you. 

Why CLF? 

We are a diverse and inclusive community of 37 academies across five cluster regions in the South West that is committed to excellence and making a positive impact. Our people bring unique perspectives, but we’re all driven by a shared moral purpose and a passion for making a positive impact, whether in a teaching, leadership or support role. We’re proud to foster a culture where everyone can thrive, feel valued, and make a meaningful difference to the lives of others. 

We are an equal opportunity employer and proud to serve a diverse student population and our communities. We strongly believe that representation matters. We particularly encourage applicants from those groups in order to represent the students we serve, as well as wider underrepresented groups including gender, transgender, age disability, sexual orientation or religion. 

What we can offer you:  

  • Access to the Teachers’ Pension Scheme.  
  • Comprehensive induction and ongoing support for career development and wellbeing.   
  • Sector-leading professional development entitlement and opportunities.  
  • Collaboration with colleagues across the trust through subject communities and specialist networks.  
  • Shared CLF curriculum, written and curated by trust experts, reducing individual teacher workload.    
  • Career enhancing and progression opportunities within the trust and through the CLF Institute.  
  • A collaborative culture which supports workload.  
  • Well-being support through an Employee Assistance Programme.  
  • Health benefits, including wellness sessions, gym discounts, and flu jabs.  
  • A range of generous family leave options, including above industry average occupational maternity pay.  
  • Additional benefits like cycle to work scheme, on-site parking and many more!  

Recruitment timeline:   

Academy Tours: w/c 2 November 2026  

Closing Date: 8 November 2026 @ 11.59pm  

Shortlisting Date: 9 November 2026 

Interview Date: 17 November 2026  

We welcome visits from potential candidates.

If you would like to arrange a school visit prior to the closing date, please contact our Operations Manager Phoebe Coke at Summerhill Academy – Phoebe.Coke @clf.uk 

How to apply: 

Please complete a full application form via the Eteach website. As part of our commitment to Keeping Children Safe in Education (KCSIE), we do not accept CVs – a full education and employment history must be provided through the application form.   

Please note: There is a requirement on page 24 of the Candidate Information Pack for you to include requested information within the Supporting Statement section of the application form. This information will be reviewed during short-listing, as part of your application for this role. The Supporting Statement section does not allow anything over an 8,000-character limit - this is equivalent to 2/3 pages of text in Word, depending on spacing/formatting used. description:
Job Title: Teacher of Design and Technology 

Actual Annual Salary: £17,955 - £27,845 (M1 - UPS3 based on 0.6 FTE)

Contract Type: Permanent

Provisional Start Date: 01 January 2027 (Subject to completion of pre-employment checks) 

Your opportunity to deliver outstanding Design and Technology lessons and inspire the next generation of designers, engineers and problem-solvers 

We are seeking a passionate and dynamic Teacher of Design and Technology to join Broadoak Academy from January 2027. You will play a key role in delivering a broad and engaging DT curriculum that fosters creativity, develops technical skills, and ignites a love of innovation in our students. 

At Broadoak Academy, you will join an established and collaborative Design and Technology team, supported by dedicated technicians who assist with lesson delivery and preparation. Our well-equipped facilities include specialist workshops, kitchens, and textiles classrooms, all resourced with modern equipment to enhance both your teaching and students’ learning experiences. 

As a teacher within CLF, you will set high expectations that inspire and challenge pupils, create a safe and stimulating learning environment, and support all students to make strong progress regardless of their starting points. You will contribute to the design and delivery of an ambitious curriculum, helping students to build practical skills, resilience, and confidence both within and beyond the classroom. 

We are looking for an inspirational teacher who is committed to delivering excellent educational experiences. You will have the opportunity to use your talents to play a key role in championing the success and life chances of all children across our trust. Through our commitment to high standards, a joy-filled and contemporary curriculum, and excellent teaching, we aim to create greater opportunities for lifelong success as our pupils grow into confident young adults. 

About you: 

You will be: 

  • a qualified teacher or hold an equivalent teaching qualification with strong subject knowledge in Design and Technology 
  • able to deliver a high-quality Design and Technology curriculum and teach engaging, well-structured lessons that promote creativity, independence and a love of learning 
  • able to plan sequences of learning that build on prior knowledge and enable all pupils to make good progress, using effective assessment to inform teaching 
  • able to differentiate effectively to meet the needs of all learners, including those from key identified groups such as pupil premium, looked after children, SEND and high attaining students 
  • committed to creating a safe and stimulating learning environment where high expectations of behaviour and mutual respect underpin strong relationships 
  • a strong communicator with the ability to build positive relationships with students, staff and parents, and contribute positively to the wider life of the academy 
  • proactive in developing your own teaching practice, reflective in your approach and committed to continuous professional development 
  • committed to equality, diversity and inclusion, championing the success and life chances of all children 
  • willing to contribute to enrichment opportunities beyond the classroom, enhancing students’ experiences and engagement with Design and Technology 

Applicants are advised to refer to the full requirements of the role in the attached job description and person specification, prior to submitting an application. 

About Broadoak Academy: 

Broadoak Academy is an ever-growing secondary school located in Weston-super-Mare and is quickly becoming the school of choice for parents in the town. We are very proud to be an Ofsted-rated ‘Good’ school. We have a strong sense of belonging and community, and as such, we work together to offer students a well-balanced, happy and successful education. Our community is assured of Broadoak’s pivotal role in their children’s education, wellbeing and futures. 

Why CLF? 

We are a diverse and inclusive community of 37 academies across five cluster regions in the South West that is committed to excellence and making a positive impact. Our people bring unique perspectives, but we’re all driven by a shared moral purpose and a passion for making a positive impact, whether in a teaching, leadership or support role. We’re proud to foster a culture where everyone can thrive, feel valued, and make a meaningful difference to the lives of others. 

We are an equal opportunity employer and proud to serve a diverse student population and our communities. We strongly believe that representation matters and so encourage applications from underrepresented and global majority groups including ethnicity, gender, transgender, age, disability, sexual orientation or religion.  

We aim to remove any barriers to employment, ensuring everyone can compete on equal terms. Job share, part-time and flexible working opportunities will be considered. 

What we can offer you: 

  • Access to the Teachers’ Pension Scheme. 
  • Comprehensive induction and ongoing support for career development and wellbeing.  
  • Sector-leading professional development entitlement and opportunities. 
  • Collaboration with colleagues across the trust through subject communities and specialist networks. 
  • Shared CLF curriculum, written and curated by trust experts, reducing individual teacher workload.   
  • Career enhancing and progression opportunities within the trust and through the CLF Institute. 
  • A collaborative culture which supports workload. 
  • Well-being support through an Employee Assistance Programme. 
  • Health benefits, including wellness sessions, gym discounts, and flu jabs. 
  • A range of generous family leave options, including above industry average occupational maternity pay. 
  • Additional benefits like cycle to work scheme, on-site parking and many more! 

Recruitment timeline: 

Closing Date: 06 November 2026 @11.59am

Shortlisting: 07 November 2026

Interviews: 12 November 2026

We welcome visits from potential candidates. If you would like to arrange a school visit prior to the closing date, please contact the academy/site directly to arrange a suitable appointment. 

As part of our commitment to Keeping Children Safe in Education (KCSIE), we do not accept CVs – a full education and employment history must be provided through our application form.  

Skilled Worker sponsorship: This role may be eligible for Skilled Worker visa sponsorship, subject to the candidate meeting the applicable Home Office eligibility and salary requirements. Full-time and 0.8 FTE positions will generally meet the required salary threshold; for other part-time working arrangements, eligibility will depend on the salary applicable to the role and the candidate's working pattern. To help us assess whether sponsorship may be available, we encourage candidates who require sponsorship to provide their current salary information when completing the application form. 

We reserve the right to close this vacancy early, should we receive a high level of interest in the role. Therefore, candidates are advised to apply at their earliest convenience to avoid missing out.    

As a Disability Confident Committed Employer, we are dedicated to equity and inclusion and commit to interviewing applicants with a disability who meet the essential criteria. We aim to provide an inclusive and accessible recruitment process, and support employees throughout their employment. title: Product Manager
description:
Headquarters: Remote • Germany, Canada, France, Spain or the UK

 About Upsun (formerly Platform.sh)

 Upsun is the cloud application platform humans and robots love. It is built for today’s hybrid teams, where AI agents write and test code and humans focus on solving the problems that really matter. Developers, DevOps engineers, and platform teams use Upsun to build, ship, and scale confidently without wrestling with backend infrastructure. We give you your time back. You get:

• Predictable performance, even at scale

• Secure, compliant environments by default

• Real-time observability and profiling built in

• Cloning, configuration, and provisioning in seconds

• AI-ready features that plug directly into your stack

 The name says it all. "Up" means uptime, reliability, and acceleration. "Sun" reflects our follow-the-sun-support, a 24x7, globally distributed support team keeping the lights on while you rest. Our core belief is that software should power brighter solutions and greater innovation.

 Upsunners are a remote, global workforce, and we thrive in a multicultural team. We are committed to open source and an open, welcoming environment. Our team spans the globe and the experience spectrum.

 What's our commonality, our cultural fabric? A curious spirit and a thirst for knowledge; an eagerness for innovative ideas and cultures. We believe we can build anything together in an environment that frees you to do your best work.

 Our values:

 We make a positive impact.

 We aim for the stars.

 We care for each other.

 Impact of a Product Manager

 As a Product Manager at Upsun, you own a significant area of Upsun Cloud, our cloud application platform, and the outcomes it delivers for the developers who build on it. The team you join owns the platform's foundations: the API, the runtime, environments, and the reliability every application running on Upsun depends on. And because Upsun is the cloud application platform humans and robots love, much of what you build will be used by AI agents as much as by people.

 This is a hands-on, technically rich role that bridges product strategy and deep infrastructure understanding. You own the strategy and the roadmap for your area, working closely with engineering to define platform behavior, build scalable abstractions, and shape workflows that empower modern development teams. Throughout, you act as the key voice for the user, making sure everything we ship contributes meaningfully to an exceptional developer experience.

 What to expect

•
 Strategy and roadmap: Own the strategy, roadmap, and priorities for your area of Upsun Cloud, balancing established foundations with uncharted territory.

•
 Problem definition: Synthesize inputs from customers, support, sales, and engineering into clear problem statements, constructively testing underlying assumptions.

•
 Solution definition: Explore options with your team, weigh trade-offs, and land on the right scope.

•
 Ship small, iterate fast: Release in increments and shorten the loop between shipping and learning.

•
 Technical execution: Collaborate with engineering (especially infrastructure and systems teams) to deliver platform capabilities that are reliable, scalable, and developer-friendly.

•
 Design for humans and agents: Build with two audiences in mind—ensuring features, APIs, documentation, and error messages serve both people and AI agents.

•
 Customer and data authority: Connect with customers regularly, serve as an internal advocate for their needs, and define metrics that demonstrate value for users and the business.

•
 Influence across teams: Build alignment across engineering, design, Product Marketing, support, and leadership.

•
 Go-to-market: Partner with Product Marketing early so go-to-market strategy helps shape the product, not just the launch.

 What you bring

•
 Product management experience: Proven experience in product management owning a distinct product area, ideally focused on developer platforms, PaaS, or cloud infrastructure.

•
 Technical depth: Understanding of building, deploying, and running applications in the cloud, with the ability to collaborate closely with infrastructure engineers on multi-tenant architectures or distributed systems.

•
 Software development background: Familiarity with building software using languages such as Python, Ruby, JavaScript, PHP, Go, or Rust.

•
 CI/CD, containers & APIs: Hands-on experience or close collaboration with CI/CD workflows, Docker/OCI container technologies, and a clear vision for intuitive API design.

•
 AI fluency: Daily use of modern AI tools to research, draft, and prototype workflows, paired with a realistic understanding of where current tools and models fall short.

•
 Agentic development: A strong perspective on autonomous agent architecture and how agentic workflows are transforming modern software engineering.

•
 Navigating ambiguity: Comfort with turning unstructured problem spaces into clear strategies and taking thoughtful action even with incomplete information.

•
 Collaborative communication: Clear written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of listening, building consensus, and uniting teams around a shared vision.

•
 Data-informed decision making: Ability to seek out and evaluate data to guide decisions and track success.

 Bonus points for

• Enthusiasm for using and testing the platform capabilities you help build.

•
 Experience using Kubernetes, or building self-service platforms on Kubernetes

 Where we hire

 At Upsun, remote work isn't just a trend - it's our foundation. The freedom of remote work with the support of a diverse, global team has been our successful model for over a decade. Our culture celebrates flexibility and collaboration, and while we have team members in over 30 countries around the globe, we are currently focused on hiring for this role in Germany, Canada, Spain, France, and the UK . Although we’re unable to provide visa sponsorship at this time, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates who are legally authorized to work in these countries.

 How we hire

 We know that a great hire won’t meet every requirement that we’ve outlined. If you can see yourself elevating the team, we want to hear your story. Few of us would be here had we not taken a chance.

 You can expect 5 video interviews on Google Meet to follow the order below. Should you successfully move through the entire process you will have the opportunity to meet with a variety of Upsunners. Our goal is to ensure you can make the most informed decision on whether this role, and our culture aligns with what you’re looking for in your future working environment.

• 45 Minutes with Talent Acquisition

• 60 Minutes with Hiring Manager (Director, Product)

• 60 Minutes with Team (IC's)

• 60 Minutes with Product Leaders

• 45 Minutes with Executive (CTO)

 All roles require background checks.

 What we offer

 A product you can believe in - Join us in transforming how businesses build and manage web applications, driven making a positive impact as a proud B Corp .

 An Award-Winning Workplace - We’ve been recognized by Forbes’ Top 30 Companies for Remote Jobs and France’s Best Workplaces for Women.

 ️ A culture that values your voice - Join a flexible, open, and inclusive work environment where your voice is encouraged, and your ideas shape our growth and evolution.

 A global team - Collaborate with colleagues from diverse backgrounds across the world, embracing different perspectives

 Benefits and perks - Make the most of what matters to you

 Flexible PTO

 Comprehensive healthcare coverage (UK, Canada, France, Spain, USA)

 Company stock options

 Professional development budget

 Office equipment budget

 ‍️ Wellness budget

 Annual team gatherings

 Internet reimbursement

 Inclusive parental leave

 ️ Remote work travel program

 You belong here

 At Upsun, we celebrate diversity in all its forms and are committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable, and supportive workplace where everyone can thrive. We embrace and value different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences, because they make us stronger as a team. Whoever you are, wherever you're from, and whatever path you've taken, you are welcome here. We encourage you to bring your whole self to work, connect with others, and share your passion. If you need accommodations at any stage of our hiring process, please let us know. We're here to ensure an accessible and comfortable experience for you.

 To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/upsun-product-manager

title: Customer Success Manager, EMEA
description:
Headquarters: Austria (remote); UK (remote)

 Role Purpose:

 The Senior Customer Success Manager will own a portfolio of enterprise and mid-market accounts across EMEA. This is not a relationship management role — it is a value consulting role. You will bring deep expertise in fraud, identity, and compliance to help customers design optimal identity strategies and realize measurable risk reduction outcomes. You will be expected to understand your customers’ business deeply, make the value Jumio delivers visible and quantifiable, and act as the connective tissue between the value that was promised during the sale and the value the customer achieves.

You will work closely with Account Managers on renewal and expansion, with the implementation team during the critical customer onboarding and adoption stages, and with Product and Support to close the loop on customer feedback. You will be a named owner of customer health — accountable for knowing which accounts are at risk, why, and what you are doing about it.

 This role is well-suited to someone who is commercially-minded, data-fluent, and energized by the complexity of enterprise customer relationships. You will be joining at a moment of intentional transformation — there is a significant opportunity to shape how Jumio’s customer success motion operates going forward.

 Responsibilities:

 Customer Health & Retention

• Own the health of a portfolio of EMEA enterprise and mid-market accounts — you are accountable for knowing which are green, yellow, or red and why

• Monitor customer health signals continuously: product utilization, support ticket trends, NPS, executive engagement, and contract consumption pace

• Identify early warning signs of dissatisfaction or disengagement before they surface as churn risk — act on health score drops immediately, don’t wait for the customer to raise the issue

• Own escalation when product gaps or recurring issues are impacting customer outcomes — and close the feedback loop by communicating back to the customer what Jumio is doing

• Ensure open support issues are resolved to the customer’s satisfaction and that unresolved issues never reach a renewal conversation

 Fraud & Compliance Advisory

• Serve as a subject matter expert on fraud, identity verification, AML, and digital risk management for your customer portfolio

• Advise customer risk and fraud teams on emerging fraud vectors, industry best practices, and regulatory developments relevant to their business

• Evaluate customer risk profiles and provide expert recommendations on verification workflow optimization, risk mitigation, and user friction tradeoffs

• Identify compliance and regulatory hurdles that may impact product adoption and coordinate with internal teams to resolve them.

 Value Realization & ROI

• Confirm customers are seeing the outcomes they expected — pass rates, conversion improvement, fraud reduction, compliance — and make that value visible and quantifiable

• Own the business outcomes scorecard for each account: track the metrics that matter to the customer and report on them proactively

• Prepare and lead regular business reviews (EBRs) that drive decisions — not just report on usage

• Connect Jumio’s performance back to the customer’s original business goals and make the ROI case clearly before the AM enters a commercial conversation

• Address gaps between what was promised during the sale and what the customer is experiencing — proactively, not reactive

 Adoption & Platform Success

• Monitor feature adoption — ensure customers are using everything they paid for and that underutilized capabilities are proactively introduced

• Train new users as the customer’s team grows or changes, and keep the customer current on new features and product updates relevant to their use case

• Build a joint success plan aligned to the customer’s evolving business goals — a living document, not a one-time exercise

• Partner with the cross-functional teams during the post-go-live period to ensure customers reach full adoption

 Relationships & Executive Engagement

• Build and maintain multi-threaded relationships across the customer organization — not just the day-to-day contact

• Expand relationships to business leaders and executives: a single-threaded account is a renewal risk

• Identify and nurture champions within each account who will advocate for Jumio internally

• Invite engaged customers into the Jumio community — user groups, advisory boards, reference programs

 Expansion & Commercial Partnership

• Spot signals that a customer is ready for more — new use cases, new geographies, increased volume, new compliance requirements

• Surface expansion opportunities to the Account Manager with a clear business case grounded in the customer’s current deployment and proven value

• Support the AM in building the commercial case for expansion — you have the customer relationship and the data; the AM has the commercial motion

• Identify satisfied customers who could become references, case studies, or advisory board members

 Skills, Experience and Qualifications:

• Multiple years of practitioner experience in Fraud, Identity, AML, or Digital Risk Management — you have worked inside a fraud or compliance function, not just sold to one

• Strong consultative and analytical thinking with a focus on risk strategy and workflow design

• Ability to distill complex fraud and compliance concepts into clear, value-driven narratives for executive stakeholders

• Proven track record managing enterprise accounts with $500K+ ARR — you have owned renewal conversations and have GRR/NRR data to support your candidacy

• Demonstrated ability to conduct executive-level business reviews that drive outcomes, not just report activity

• Experience building and maintaining customer health frameworks and success plans

• Commercial acumen: you understand the connection between customer health and revenue, and you can have credible conversations with economic buyers

• Data fluency: you are comfortable working with product usage data, building ROI narratives, and using a CS platform (Planhat, Gainsight, Totango, or equivalent)

• Strong communication and executive presence — you are as comfortable presenting to the C-Suite as you are troubleshooting with a technical team
Proactive by nature: you identify risks before customers do and you act without waiting to be asked

 Preferred Qualifications:

• Familiarity with API-based or technically complex SaaS products — you do not need to be an engineer, but you need to be comfortable in technical conversations

• Experience working in a PE-backed or high-growth transformation environment

• Prior experience building or contributing to CS playbooks, health score models, or QBR frameworks

 What Success Looks Like:

In your first 90 days:

• You have a clear health rating for every account in your portfolio and a plan for every yellow and red account

• You have met the key stakeholders at each account and established a regular operating cadence

• You understand the business outcomes each customer is trying to achieve and whether Jumio is delivering them

• You have identified the top 3 accounts at renewal risk and have an active plan in place

 By end of year one:

• GRR across your portfolio is at or above target

• Every account has a current success plan, a health score, and an EBR cadence

• You have surfaced expansion opportunities to the AM team with qualified business cases

• Customer satisfaction scores across your portfolio are trending upward

 Compensation:

 We offer an annual full-time salary (38.5 hr week) of min 80,000 EUR gross, with a possible overpayment depending on qualifications and experience.
 Jumio Values:

 IDEAL: Integrity, Diversity, Empowerment, Accountability, Leading Innovation

 Equal Opportunities :

 Jumio is a collaboration of people with different ideas, strengths, interests and cultures. We welcome applications and colleagues from all backgrounds and of all statuses.

 About Jumio:

 Jumio is a B2B technology company dedicated to eradicating online identity fraud, money laundering and other financial crimes to help make the internet safer. We leverage AI, biometrics, machine learning, liveness detection and automation to create solutions that are trusted by leading brands worldwide and respected by industry thought leaders.

 Jumio is the leading provider of online identity verification, eKYC and AML solutions. With a global footprint, we’re expanding the team to meet strong client demand across a range of industries including Financial Services, Travel, Sharing Economy, Fintech, Gaming, and others.

 Applicant Data Privacy

 We will only use your personal information in connection with Jumio’s application, recruitment, and hiring processes, as described in Jumio’s Applicant Privacy Notice. If you have any questions or comments, please send an email to privacy@jumio.com .

 To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/jumio-customer-success-manager-emea

title: Machine Learning Engineer - Subscriptions
description:
At Spotify, our Subscriptions Mission focuses on creating experiences that help listeners discover the value of Spotify, become subscribers, and stay with us for the long term. By combining technology, experimentation, and a deep understanding of our users, we help connect artists and fans while building a sustainable subscription business.

Within the Subscriptions Mission, the Subs Foundational Models Product Area is part of the Subs User Understanding Studio. We build scalable machine learning solutions that personalize the subscriber journey, from conversion through to long-term retention. Working closely with teams across the mission, we develop ML solutions that improve key business metrics, including subscriber growth, monthly active users, and Premium retention.

title: Engineering - Internal AI Transformation
location: Canada,  Germany,  Ireland,  Italy,  Poland,  Sweden,  UK,  USA
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

The role / impact
As an Internal AI Engineer at ElevenLabs, you'll be embedded at the frontier of how we scale - acting as a forward-deployed engineer across our GTM, Operations, and Finance teams. You won't just build tools; you'll co-design and ship agentic AI workflows that eliminate manual toil and fundamentally reshape how our people operate.

Your impact goes beyond the code. You'll own high-stakes automations from discovery to production, acting as a technical partner to internal teams. The patterns, guardrails, and tooling you define will become the blueprint other teams reach for - the standard for how ElevenLabs harnesses AI safely and at speed.

The team / how we work
You'll join a lean, high-velocity team with a shared obsession: turning broken, manual processes into elegant automated systems. We move fast through rapid experimentation, work closely with operators and business owners to uncover the real problem, and ship pragmatic solutions without waiting for perfect specs.

What you'll actually be working on

  • Designing and iterating on AI agents and workflow orchestrations using tools like ElevenAgents, Claude, and n8n.

  • Integrating AI systems with our core business stack - Salesforce, Slack, Ashby, and more

  • Building reusable automation services, patterns and shared templates that multiply the output of every team you touch

  • Owning experiments end-to-end: spotting the opportunity, building the solution, and measuring the impact

  • Developing evaluation and monitoring frameworks so our AI-native workflows are reliable, auditable, and safe

    What we're looking for

  • Proven experience building and shipping automations or applications in production - you know what it takes to go from fuzzy business pain to something real teams depend on

  • AI-First Instincts: Strong familiarity with LLM capabilities, prompting strategies, RAG patterns, and a genuine passion for building agentic workflows.

  • Deep Backend Expertise : Strong Python and SQL and system design patterns (APIs, webhooks, orchestration layers)

  • A systems-thinking mindset : you design with security, auditability, and blast radius in mind from the start

  • Builder and AI-First instincts: you don't wait to be told what to build - you spot the pattern, propose the fix, and ship it.

  • Infra & DevOps Instincts: Hands-on experience operating cloud infrastructure (GCP preferred), Kubernetes, Docker, and enterprise authentication flows

Location

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw. Specific teams may have specific location preferences.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

title: Senior Product Designer - Growth
description:
Fully Remote (UK based) | Competitive Salary + Bonus + Generous Equity | B Corp Certified

TrustedHousesitters is a fast growing, direct-to-consumer marketplace that is redefining pet care and travel.

Here at TrustedHousesitters, we’re on a mission to make travel work better for pets, for their people, and for the global community of animal lovers who look after them. We’ve got big plans on becoming the world’s most-loved travel solution for pet people. We’ve built something pretty special: a trusted place where pet owners and sitters connect to keep pets happy at home while their humans explore the world.

We’ve already grown into a global community with members in over 140 countries, a product people genuinely love, and a team of more than 100 brilliant humans powering it all.

But we’re only just getting started. Our goal? To grow to 1 million members and make TrustedHousesitters the world’s most-loved travel solution for pet people.

At the moment, a sit starts every two minutes somewhere on the planet. We want that to be every single minute and we know the only way we’ll get there is with the right people in the right roles.

The right people in the right roles will shape our future. So, here’s the big question: Could that be you?

This is the role that owns the first impression. From the moment someone lands on our homepage to the point they hand over their payment details, you’ll shape every critical step. We’re redesigning how millions of pet lovers discover and join TrustedHousesitters - and this hire will lead that work. If you’ve spent your career moving conversion needles, experimenting relentlessly, and building beautiful product at speed, this is your next chapter.

The Role: Experimental, Visual, and Commercial

You’ll own the full acquisition and onboarding experience at TrustedHousesitters - web and mobile - sitting within the New Member Revenue squad. That means everything from the homepage and landing pages through to registration flows, onboarding nudges, and first payment. You’ll work directly with product, engineering, data, CRM, and our CRO Manager, and you’ll have real ownership of the experimentation roadmap for your area.

The challenge is genuinely interesting. Our product is loved - but our acquisition experience needs to match that. We’re running ‘Project Heartbeat’: a push to make TrustedHousesitters feel as aspirational as Airbnb, peppering real trust signals and community moments into journeys that currently skew too utilitarian. You’ll need to balance a high visual bar with a rigorous test-and-learn mindset. Neither alone is enough.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Own the acquisition journey end-to-end: From homepage to first payment - web-first, with mobile increasingly in scope - including landing pages, onboarding flows, and lifecycle nudges.

  • Drive conversion through experimentation: Co-own the experimentation roadmap with our CRO Manager: frame hypotheses, define success metrics, and ship rapid tests. You should be able to name the number your last test moved.

  • Raise the visual bar: Strong UI craft is a non-negotiable - every surface you touch should feel considered, current, and well-executed.

  • Translate insight into shipped product: Self-serve with Amplitude, turn quantitative and qualitative signals into testable ideas, and move quickly from insight to design.

  • Shape strategy, not just output: Partner with product, engineering, data, and commercial teams - your voice should be in the room before decisions are made, not after.

    Who you are:

    • The Growth Designer: You’ve owned acquisition or conversion work in-house, at pace - and you can tell the story of an experiment you ran, the hypothesis behind it, and the number it moved.

    • The Visual Craftsperson: Your portfolio stops people. You’ve worked where the visual bar is genuinely high and you hold yourself to that standard regardless of where you are.

    • The Hypothesis Writer: You think in problems before solutions - you can frame a clear problem statement, propose a test, and explain why that test design makes sense.

    • The Collaborator: You treat design as a shared effort, not a hand-off - you partner closely with PMs, engineers, data, and CRM and you’re a stronger designer for it.

    • The B2C Product Thinker: You’ve worked on consumer products - ideally marketplaces or subscriptions - and you understand how trust is built digitally and what actually makes someone convert.

    The Process:

    We value your time and aim for a transparent, efficient process:

    1. Talent Screen: A 20-minute conversation with our Talent team to cover your background, motivations, and the role in detail.

    2. Hiring Manager Interview: A 30-minute call with our Director of Design - a two-way conversation about your craft, your approach to growth design, and whether TrustedHousesitters is the right fit for you.

    3. Portfolio & Technical Review: A deeper session with the team focused on your case studies, your experimentation thinking, and your approach to strategic and UX challenges.

    4. Final Stage: You’ll share a high-level view of what you’d focus on in your first 90 days - not a polished strategy, just your honest read of the opportunity and what you’d want to dig into.

Compensation

Additional Information

In addition to a competitive salary and bonus, we offer a range of benefits, including:

For the love of pets

  • Each year, you’ll get a Premium TrustedHousesitters Combined membership which includes benefits like free airport lounge passes, Sit Cancellation Plan and Home and Contents Plan, plus five Premium memberships to gift to friends and family
  • Our team can work remotely from as many house sits as they like, and we contribute up to £500 per
    year towards travel costs to and from sits
  • Find a rescue pet to join your family and we’ll cover the adoption fees, as well as “pawternity” to help your pet settle into their new home

Health & wellbeing

  • SimplyHealth healthcare cash plan
  • Bupa Health Insurance and Dental Insurance plan
  • Specsavers eyecare scheme
  • Weekly virtual yoga sessions
  • Optional enrollment onto our Trusted Giving scheme, which includes employee giving via Charities Trust and 2 days paid annual volunteering allowance

Working environment

  • Work fully remotely from anywhere in the world - as long as you follow compliance as a UK tax resident
  • Get £200 to spend on home office equipment each year + Macbook and Apple accessories when you start
  • Access to Spaces co-working locations across the globe
  • We host an all-expenses-paid meetup each quarter and fund team events (remote or in-person) throughout the year
  • We cover the costs of personal development resources and have regular time set aside for learning and growth
  • Depending on your role within the business, you’ll have the option to customise your work hours to better align with your personal schedule

Compensation & time off

  • 25 days off per year, plus bank holidays and festive closure between Christmas and New Year (36 days + Christmas Day for some roles)
  • Competitive salary which is reviewed annually
  • Generous equity package for permanent employees
  • Discretionary 10% quarterly bonus scheme, distributed quarterly
  • Pension scheme: 5% from you as an employee and 3% from TrustedHousesitters
  • £500 recruitment referral bonus

If you're ready to join us on our mission to become the most loved pet travel solution, we'd love to hear from you!

In your application, please feel free to note which pronouns you use (For example- she/her/hers, he/him/his, they/them/theirs, etc).

At the heart of our team are a mix of diverse backgrounds. Here at TrustedHousesitters, we’re committed to the equal opportunities policy throughout the interview process and selection. Offers of employment into TrustedHousesitters are based solely on individual merit, qualifications, and the person's professional suitability.

Gender identity, sexual orientation, marital or civil partnership status, colour, race, nationality, ethnic or national origins, religion or beliefs, age, mental or physical disability, medical condition, pregnancy or maternity status, or any other protected characteristics do not enter into our decision-making process.
